##### Project general facts

Wadi Villas by Arista Properties is an exclusive gated enclave conceived as a private retreat, where tranquillity, greenery and architectural elegance come together. Flowing forms meet crisp horizontal lines, while facades in light natural tones with textured panels, decorative screens and panoramic glazing create a stepped composition of terraces and balconies. The homes rise above a basement level and a ground floor to two upper floors, offering four- and five-bedroom villas and six-bedroom mansions.

Residents enjoy a clubhouse with a lap pool, a fitness centre, a cafe, a library, a game room and a multi-purpose lounge, along with a co-working lounge for those working from home. A rainforest boardwalk, internal courtyards, hidden gardens and water features create a secluded, restorative atmosphere, while indoor and outdoor children's play areas, a barbecue terrace, landscaped walkways and round-the-clock security complete the shared offer for families.

Interiors follow a contemporary style with natural materials and a soft colour palette, based on an open-plan concept with subtle zoning and panoramic windows that bring in abundant natural light. Generous living and dining areas flow onto terraces and gardens, while bedroom suites offer privacy and comfort. Homes are delivered semi-furnished, with fitted kitchens and appliances, leaving loose furniture to the owner's own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Meydan is a prestigious green district in the heart of Dubai, known for the Meydan Racecourse, Meydan Hotel and the Mohammed Bin Rashid City master plan. District Eleven offers a calm residential setting of villas and mansions surrounded by landscaped parks, lagoons, jogging tracks and cycling paths, while schools, clinics and community retail cover everyday needs close to home.

Al Khail Road, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Meydan Road connect residents with the wider city. Business Bay, Downtown Dubai and The Dubai Mall are a short drive away, the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary is close by, and Dubai International Airport, Dubai Creek Harbour and Dubai Design District are within comfortable reach for work and leisure.

Meydan is a freehold area open to international buyers and one of the most sought-after villa addresses in central Dubai. Large, design-led villas and mansions with private gardens are in limited supply close to Downtown Dubai, attracting high-net-worth families and premium tenants. A central position, green surroundings and an established lifestyle offer underpin long-term value and capital growth for owners.
